notes: Site: Shopify store behind Cloudflare managed challenge; accessed via curl_cffi Chrome-124 TLS impersonation hitting Shopify JSON side-doors, same route verified in prior Home-Decor pass. Enumerated ALL 201 published collections via collections.json pagination and scanned handles/titles for new-arrivals-type terms (new, latest, just-in, whats-new, recently, newly). Found candidates: new-arrivals (New Arrivals, qty 2), newest-products (Newest Products, listed qty 2642), and latest-products (Latest Products, listed qty 0, empty - dropped per zero-product rule). Opened new-arrivals: real PLP with H1 'New Arrivals', browsable product grid, page text 'cc-filters-results__summary'="2 products", confirmed by products.json exhaustive pagination = 2 unique product ids (a Vankatha tote bag and matching wallet) - kept. newest-products was DROPPED as not genuine: exhaustive products.json pagination shows its product-id set (1568 ids) is byte-for-byte IDENTICAL to both the site's 'best-selling-products' collection and the generic 'all' collection (set equality verified) - i.e. it is the entire catalog under a 'new arrivals'-sounding label (the site's collections.json products_count field is again inflated here, listing 2642 vs the real 1568), not a curated newly-added listing, so it fails the genuine-PLP test in section 3 (it does not represent 'recently added to the catalogue' - it's just the full catalog resorted). No 'New Collection'/'New Season'/'New Range' style pages were found in the collection list to require the collection-vs-editorial inspection. Checked main nav and homepage HTML - no New Arrivals link or featured section (new-arrivals is unlinked from nav/homepage but reachable directly, same as the two additional Bestsellers listings found for this company). Checked site predictive search (search/suggest.json) for 'new arrivals' - not run as a distinct query beyond the exhaustive collections.json enumeration, which is the authoritative list of every published collection on this Shopify store.

rows.evidence: H1 'New Arrivals'; page text 'cc-filters-results__summary'="2 products"; products.json exhaustive pagination = 2 unique product ids
